description_en: Query the details of the corresponding video synthesis Job by using the TaskUuid generated upon Job submission. This API supports querying details for both 3D digital human and 2D digital human video synthesis Jobs.
description_zh: 通过提交任务生成的TaskUuid，查询对应视频合成任务详情。同时支持3D数字人和2D数字人的视频合成任务详情查询
kebab_example: aliyun avatar get-video-task-info --tenant-id 1 --app AppId=3d95xx946a --task-uuid xxxx-xxxx-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVideoTaskInfo

parameters.help_en: The TenantId obtained from the digitized virtual human Open Platform.
parameters.help_zh: 从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en: App ID. You can obtain the corresponding appId on the Developer Center > Instance Management page. References (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/479093.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f66c95dI2Ee#6a48daa1ee899).
fields.help_zh: App ID。在开发者中心-实例管理页面获取对应的appId，参考文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/479093.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f66c95dI2Ee#6a48daa1ee899)
fields.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The job UUID, which is returned when you submit the corresponding Video generation job.
parameters.help_zh: 任务UUID，提交对应视频生成任务时返回的TaskUuid
parameters.name: task_uuid
